data.long_meaning: Dayna is derived from the Greek word 'daimon' which means 'god' or 'spirit'. In Greek mythology, a daimon was a supernatural being that could be benevolent or malevolent. The name Dayna carries the meaning “Little” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Dayna usually hope their child will grow to embody little and live with faith, good character and purpose.
